name: The Bubble Tea Galaxy
description: A swirling galaxy made entirely of bubble tea with tapioca pearls as stars and milky way streams flowing through cosmic space.
prompt: A whimsical galaxy formed from swirling bubble tea, with tapioca pearls glowing like stars and spiral arms of creamy milk forming nebulae. Floating boba spheres drift through space, leaving trails of sweetness. Colorful straws twist like comets across a pastel cosmic backdrop. Ultra-vibrant colors, surreal space fantasy, high detail, dreamlike atmosphere.
caption: One sip and you're floating through the Milky Way... literally! 🧋🌌
